# Reading Order

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ReadingOrder`](gmeow-ReadingOrder.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ReadingOrder>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A standpoint that supplies a subjective ordering for consuming segments of a work — publication order, internal chronology, author-recommended order, or fandom order. Never canonical ontology truth; claims are annotated [`gmeow:accordingTo`](../properties/gmeow-accordingTo.md) a [`ReadingOrder`](gmeow-ReadingOrder.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Standpoint`](gmeow-Standpoint.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ReadingOrder`](gmeow-ReadingOrder.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Standpoint`](gmeow-Standpoint.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Standpoint`](gmeow-Standpoint.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to model a subjective ordering for consuming a work's segments — publication order, internal chronology, author-recommended or fandom order — that competing orderings may contradict without one being canonical.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting any ordering as canonical ontology truth (a [`ReadingOrder`](gmeow-ReadingOrder.md) is a [`gmeow:Standpoint`](gmeow-Standpoint.md), never a global fact) and avoid the bare [`gmeow:segmentIndex`](../properties/gmeow-segmentIndex.md) for it — index is structural position, reading order is perspectival.

### How to use

- Mint the ordering as a [`gmeow:ReadingOrder`](gmeow-ReadingOrder.md) standpoint and index each ordering claim with [`gmeow:accordingTo`](../properties/gmeow-accordingTo.md) that standpoint, letting co-equal orderings coexist rather than picking a primary.

### Examples

- ex:chronologicalOrder a [`gmeow:ReadingOrder`](gmeow-ReadingOrder.md). ex:claim [`gmeow:accordingTo`](../properties/gmeow-accordingTo.md) ex:chronologicalOrder.
